snippet.title: BeaconBound — A Peaceful World. A Dangerous Journey. | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Find your rhythm in a living world — and put it to the test when the guardians close in.
Roll through colorful landscapes, explore volcanic terrain and changing weather, and chase curious creatures. Then approach a beacon, outsmart its guardians, and claim the light.
Use four abilities — Pointer, Boost, Shield, and Stasis — and discover how Marble, Plastic, Metal, and Rubber change the way you move.
Every beacon is a risk. Every approach is yours to choose.
🎮 Play and wishlist BeaconBound on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4790960/BeaconBound/
